title: Measles Returned After America Cut Cases To 86
hook: America cut measles to 86 cases. Then it returned.
closing: Elimination is not permanent when vaccination gaps let measles reach classrooms again.
question: Did you know measles had been eliminated?

segments.say: America once recorded only 86 measles cases, showing how close elimination came to ending domestic spread.
Unvaccinated people made up 93% of cases, revealing where the comeback found room to spread.
The Texas outbreak reached 702 cases, showing how quickly one vulnerable pocket can grow.
